scripts.build: npm run build -w extension && npm run build -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w extension && npm run typecheck -w backend
scripts.package: npm run build -w extension && rm -f trend-analyzer-extension.zip && cd extension && zip -r ../trend-analyzer-extension.zip dist/ manifest.json icons/ sidepanel/sidepanel.css sidepanel/sidepanel.html && echo 'trend-analyzer-extension.zip ready'
scripts.package:prod: npm run bump-manifest-version && cross-env API_BASE_URL=https://trend-analyzer-extention.vercel.app/ NODE_ENV=production npm run build -w extension && rm -f trend-analyzer-extension.zip && cd extension && zip -r ../trend-analyzer-extension.zip dist/ manifest.json icons/ sidepanel/sidepanel.css sidepanel/sidepanel.html && echo 'trend-analyzer-extension.zip ready'
